content.short: Talent Protocol is a builder reputation network providing the Talent Passport and Builder Score for professionals.
content.description: Talent Protocol is a decentralized professional network and reputation layer designed to recognize impact within the Web3 ecosystem. The platform features the Talent Passport, an AI-powered profile that aggregates data from GitHub and on-chain activities to create a digital identity. Utilizing its proprietary Builder Score, the protocol provides a transparent metric that quantifies a builder's impact and credibility. Operating across networks like Base and Polygon, Talent Protocol also includes the Human Checkmark, a verification signal that distinguishes real users from bots.
content.meta: Talent Protocol provides decentralized identity and reputation tools for Web3 builders. Discover Talent Protocol and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
